presentation.description: Lets the engine offer your changes to a project you don't own — an open-source project you've forked, or any upstream you contribute to — as a pull request from your fork, carrying only your project's files and never the engine's own. It does the mechanical git a non-engineer shouldn't have to, and opening the pull request is always your call. Two things to weigh before you opt in. First, whether a change is accepted is the upstream project's decision — not yours, and not the engine's. Second, the one step that reaches the network — opening the real pull request — runs only when you actually submit; everything else is built and checked. So your first contribution would be the first time that live step runs anywhere — worth treating as the shake-out of that last step. Once it's added, you use it by asking the engine to offer a change upstream; there's no command to remember. You can leave this add-on out, and nothing else changes if you do.
presentation.setup_trigger: contribute a change to a project I don't own
